identity.notes: EN85.B is De'Longhi's code for the black Essenza Mini Nespresso machine (220-240 V EU-type variant). De'Longhi's own product pages (UK, BG, LV, EE) use the exact code EN85.B; De'Longhi manufacturer code per Coolblue is 0132194160. Nespresso sells the same machine design under its own code D30 (and C30), and other OEM codes exist (Breville BEC220/BEC250, KRUPS XN110/XN111, Magimix M115), per the shared user manual; those are not this SKU and were not used as sources. The US/Latin-American variant is EN85B without the dot (120 V); its De'Longhi support data was used only to corroborate the axis orientation of the dimensions. No De'Longhi Israel page and no official Israeli importer statement for EN85.B were found; Israeli price-comparison pages (Zap, WiseBuy) merge D30 and EN85 listings into one model page. De'Longhi's own PIM data for EN85.B contains clearly wrong fields (e.g. 'Aeroccino Milk System', 'Auto froth', and a product weight equal to the pack weight), so only fields corroborated elsewhere or displayed as text on the page were used. QA 2026-11-10: on reopening, the UK and BG De'Longhi pages and EP (s6) name EN85.B exactly; the PIM fields, the manual (s3) and the energy label (s4) could not be read, Coolblue (s5) returned 403, and the EN85B support page (s7) shows no technical data.

content.summary: Essenza Mini EN85.B של De'Longhi היא מכונת קפה לקפסולות Nespresso בצבע שחור. יש לה משאבה בלחץ 19 בר, התחממות של כ-25 שניות ושני כפתורים ניתנים לתכנות לאספרסו (40 מ״ל) וללונגו (110 מ״ל), עם עצירת זרימה אוטומטית. היא מתאימה למי שרוצה אספרסו או לונגו בלחיצת כפתור, בלי המתנה ארוכה להתחממות.
highlights: אספרסו 40 מ״ל ולונגו 110 מ״ל, שני הכפתורים ניתנים לתכנות
goodFor: מי ששותה בעיקר אספרסו או לונגו – שני כפתורים מוכנים בלחיצה אחת, עם כמות שאפשר לתכנת
מי שרוצה קפה מהר בבוקר – המכונה מתחממת בכ-25 שניות
considerations: המכונה עובדת עם קפסולות Nespresso, לכן כדאי לוודא שזו מערכת הקפסולות שבה אתם משתמשים
הכמויות המוגדרות בכפתורים הן 40 מ״ל לאספרסו ו-110 מ״ל ללונגו; לכמות אחרת צריך לתכנת את הכפתור

reviewFlags.issue: Power rating conflicts between manufacturer sources: De'Longhi EN85.B product data says 1150 W (matches the catalog), while the manual linked from the same page says 1200–1310 W for Essenza Mini at 220–240 V, and Coolblue says 1260 W. QA could not see any of these values on reopening. Check the rating plate on a unit in stock before publishing a wattage.

QA could not read the user manual (s3) or the energy label (s4): WebFetch returned only binary PDF data. Coolblue (s5) returned 403. Facts that rested on them were withheld: voltage, eco mode, auto-off and the 30-minute option, factory reset, emptying mode, descaling intervals, all installation steps, energy label, housing material. Facts seen only on EP (s6) were withheld as single-source: weight, water tank and removability, 6-capsule bin, Thermoblock. Re-check with a PDF text extractor (pdftotext) and a working fetch of Coolblue, then restore the rows that are confirmed.

No official Israeli importer or De'Longhi Israel page for EN85.B was found. Israeli retailer pages mention a 12-month warranty but do not tie it to an importer for this exact SKU, so no warranty row was written. Confirm the importer and warranty terms for the units the store sells.

Dimensions come from foreign retailers only, and on reopening only EP (s6) could be read, which gives width 11 cm, height 32.5 cm, depth 20.5 cm. The record's 11 × 20.5 × 32.5 cm (W × H × D) orientation could not be confirmed (Coolblue 403, De'Longhi EN85B support page shows no dimensions). Withheld as a conflict.
No source lists the box contents for EN85.B (the De'Longhi page shows only an image). Some Israeli listings mention a capsule sample pack; not verified. Left empty.
Country of manufacture was not found on any source; catalog value 'לא צוין במקורות' left as is.

Changes: 'סוג' corrected to 'מכונת קפה לקפסולות Nespresso' (no page says 'Original'); dimensions row changed to conflict (EP swaps height/depth, nothing else readable); downgraded to unverified: weight, water tank, removable tank, 6-capsule bin, Thermoblock, factory reset, voltage, eco mode, auto-off, energy label, material, plus features for eco/auto-off, reset, emptying, capsule/tank and all 5 installation items; removed unconfirmed s3/s5 refs from verified rows; feature 2 rewritten to the programmable claim s1/s2/s6 support.
